name: rules-fleet-regulations
description: Rules audit (deliberate improvement over the original): Fleet Regulations (For) - 'each player cannot have more than 4 tokens in their fleet pool'. The original only posted a reminder after the 5th token was gained. With the law in play and Mahact's fleet pool at 3, the redistribute panel's first 'Gain 1 Fleet Token' is accepted and the second is refused (engine: CommandTokensAdjustKind.validate; bot: CommandCounterButtonHandler.increaseFleetCC; status homework: StatusTokensButtonHandler.check).
